say:1:1160101201:0.text: Hey! By using this loot detector, it'll be a lot easier to find treasure. Let me show you how to use it.
say:1:1160101201:0.source_cn: 嗅！使用这个魔法信标，会很简单地找到宝藏哦！让我来告诉...

say:2:1160101202:0.text: First, <style="stress">the detectors will automatically point to the general area of the treasure</style>! But sometimes, if the area is too big, I have to spend a lot of time searching underground.
say:2:1160101202:0.source_cn: 首先，<style=stress>信标会自动指向宝藏大...

say:3:1160101203:0.text: So, multiple detectors need to be placed, and <style="stress">the intersecting area is where the treasure is</style>. This will narrow down my treasure hunt considerably!
say:3:1160101203:0.source_cn: 所以，需要摆放多枚信标，<style=stress>交...

say:4:1160101204:0.text: Finally, the true location of the treasure is <style="stress">where the area overlaps</style>. <hpy>If the loot detectors is placed directly above the treasure, I'll be able to burrow down and dig it out!</hpy>

say:5:1160101205:0.text: Remember, only <style="stress">when the loot detector is placed right on top of the treasure</style> can I dig it up and share it with you! So, let's get started!
say:5:1160101205:0.source_cn: 唔……千万要记得，只有<style=stress>魔法...
